entries.reason: Particle emitters publish query, VFX-duration, action-notify and asset-reload capabilities, while the per-frame emitter cull and simulation path must not re-resolve a module by string key.
entries.thread_affinity: Particles owner thread; the per-frame emitter cull and simulation read a pointer resolved once at the composition boundary and never re-resolve a module by string key

trim.absent_profile: minimal and other profiles without particles drop every capability listed here; remaining modules that queried them fall back to their documented absent behavior

cost_notes: The emitter cull and simulation run per frame, so their dependencies are resolved once at the composition boundary instead of per frame.
